# Moru UI

> React UI: fundamentals, behavior, technology and visual refinement. Choose npm or a source distribution, then read only the guide and components needed for your task.

- [npm package guide](https://github.com/syrus-riius/moru-ui/blob/main/packages/moru-react/README.md): the published moru-ui package, imports, provider and optional dependencies.
- [Source installation guide](https://moru-ui-lab.riius.chatgpt.site/ai/v0.4.1/start.md): registry vs source starter setup, design and interaction rules.
- [Source catalog](https://moru-ui-lab.riius.chatgpt.site/ai/v0.4.1/catalog.json): registry version 0.4.1, actual exports, dependencies and per-item source import paths.
- [Expo / React Native](https://moru-ui-lab.riius.chatgpt.site/ai/v0.4.1/expo.md): separate native source and APIs.

Moru APIs are not interchangeable with shadcn/ui. Preserve the existing project setup; consult source-derived props before generating code. Do not use registry import paths as npm package imports.
